files.description: Complete EHI Export Format Documentation — single-page HTML data dictionary covering 80 database tables with 1,246 columns. Documents the CSV export format for escribeHOST version 7.85 (dated 02/09/2026). This is the primary artifact.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the HTML data dictionary into structured JSON. Extracts table names, descriptions, column definitions, data types, nullability, PK indicators, and constraints.
Full structured data dictionary — all 80 tables with complete column-level detail (name, ordinal, dataType, isPrimaryKey, nullable, description, constraints). Machine-queryable JSON.
Table-level summary — name, description, column count, primary keys, and foreign key hints for all 80 tables.
Parsing coverage report — 80 tables discovered, 80 parsed, 0 failures, 1,246 total columns extracted.
Enrichment documentation — run commands, input boundary, output descriptions, known parsing limitations.
